title: It works.
text: It works.. I wanted a small, inexpensive entryway shoe rack, and that's what I received. It's not the best quality, and the cubbies are very small, but it works for what I wanted. My nursing shoes barely fit in one cube together, and my running shoes have to be in separate cubbies (as well as all of my husband's shoes). However, I knew this from previous reviews, and was OK with it. It's not worth a 5-star review, but since I knew what to expect, I wasn't really disappointed with it either. If you want something more sturdy (aka made out of real wood) and with better "shoe holes", you will pay more for it. If you don't have a gajillion large pairs of shoes, this product will probably work fine for you. I can fit 2 pairs of my size-6 summer sandals/flip flops in one cubby. Don't expect this thing to perform magic - it really is rather inexpensive compared to the other options out there.

These Stackable Organizers are conveniently offered in three finishes to match your decor. Espresso, Dark Cherry and White. With a furniture style look, they’ll fit right in with your home décor.
